manifest.title: Drawing Contest v1
manifest.subtitle: 5 Fireworks models · 10 SVG drawing challenges
manifest.description: Models are told to draw — a house, a cat, a snowman, a rocket, pixel-art hearts — as raw SVG markup. No canvas, no image model, just code that has to render into a picture. A deterministic verifier checks the anatomy of each drawing: right shapes, right counts, right fills, no cheating with <script>. Zero context harness, temperature 0, run via Fireworks serverless.
